plan-group.synopsis: Scholar literature-review plugin: bundled forked pdf MCP, multi-corpus persistence on better-sqlite3+Drizzle, sqlite-vec embeddings via local Ollama, five mcp-apps UI surfaces, nu CLI module, sqlite3-mcp integration.

plan.synopsis: Project scaffolding (package.json, tsconfig, Drizzle schema + migrations + sqlite-vec loader, server skeleton, tool-registry barrel with no-op stub modules, plugin manifest + .mcp.json) and the vendored forked pdf MCP with the MCP_PDF_CLIENT_ROOTS patch preserved and the roots-propagation bug fixed.
Corpus and roots tools, first-run wizard, snapshot tool for change-since-last-open, sqlite3-mcp register integration.
Ingestion adapters and tools: citation.js (BibTeX/RIS), CrossRef DOI, arXiv, manual entry.
Text extraction, chunker, Ollama embeddings, chunk_vec + reading_queue raw DDL, hybrid search, reading queue, digest and reading-prompts generation.
Annotation CRUD with bidirectional reconciliation against the child pdf MCP. Schema-compatible with the Daisy round-trip.
MCP App UI bundle (five React views, host styling, vite singlefile build) and the user-facing nu module, slash commands, and skills.
scripts/build-plugin.ts to assemble the .plugin archive. (The first-run PDF-root wizard is owned by the corpus plan, not packaging.)
